criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: The evidence confirms the agent accessed Microsoft Careers, entered the correct keyword and location, and reached a results set. Baseline score remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open one relevant Applied Scientist listing and Redmond is explicitly included in the location. Although the role is listed as Redmond + multiple other locations (not exclusively Redmond), it is still relevant to the task’s intent. Increase to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The reported job number is not supported by the visual evidence and appears fabricated relative to what was actually visible. The agent also did not say the job number was unavailable; it asserted a specific number. Score should be reduced to 0.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The work-site arrangement claimed by the agent is not visible/confirmed anywhere in the screenshots, so it is unsupported and likely fabricated. Score should be reduced to 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not provide two responsibilities in the final output. Also, its stated blocker (“only headings without bullet content”) is contradicted by screenshots showing bullet content. Even if those bullets are qualifications rather than responsibilities, the agent still failed to extract/produce any responsibilities. Score to 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent failed to report two preferred qualifications. Moreover, screenshots show at least one clearly preference-worded bullet (“big plus”), contradicting the agent’s claim that bullet content wasn’t visible. Since no preferred qualifications were provided, score to 0.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear respected: no sign-in, no application initiation, no form submission. The agent effectively stopped after working within one opened listing (though it failed to extract required info). Full credit for constraint compliance.
